title: Vāgbhaṭa's Aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitā - SARIT transcript
author: R. P. Das and R. E. Emmerick
content: a rāgādi-rogān satatānuṣaktān a-śeṣa-kāya-prasṛtān a-śeṣān |
c autsukya-mohā-rati-dāñ jaghāna yo '-pūrva-vaidyāya namo 'stu tasmai || 1 ||
a āyuḥ-kāmayamānena dharmārtha-sukha-sādhanam |
c āyur-vedopadeśeṣu vidheyaḥ param ādaraḥ || 2 ||
a brahmā smṛtvāyuṣo vedaṃ prajāpatim ajigrahat |
c so 'śvinau tau sahasrākṣaṃ so 'tri-putrādikān munīn || 3 ||
a te 'gniveśādikāṃs te tu pṛthak tantrāṇi tenire |
c tebhyo 'ti-viprakīrṇebhyaḥ prāyaḥ sāra-taroccayaḥ || 4 ||
a kriyate 'ṣṭāṅga-hṛdayaṃ nāti-saṅkṣepa-vistaram |
c kāya-bāla-grahordhvāṅga-śalya-daṃṣṭrā-jarā-vṛṣān || 5 || Ah.1.1.005v/ 1-5bv nāti-saṅkṣipta-vistṛtam
a aṣṭāv aṅgāni tasyāhuś cikitsā yeṣu saṃśritā |
c vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaś ceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ || 6 ||
a vikṛtā-vikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vartayanti ca |
c te vyāpino 'pi hṛn-nābhyor adho-madhyordhva-saṃśrayāḥ || 7 || Ah.1.1.007v/ 1-7bv ghnanti te vardhayanti ca
a vayo-'ho-rātri-bhuktānāṃ te 'nta-madhyādi-gāḥ kramāt |
c tair bhaved viṣamas tīkṣṇo mandaś cāgniḥ samaiḥ samaḥ || 8 ||
a koṣṭhaḥ krūro mṛdur madhyo madhyaḥ syāt taiḥ samair api |
c śukrārtava-sthair janmādau viṣeṇeva viṣa-krimeḥ || 9 ||
a taiś ca tisraḥ prakṛtayo hīna-madhyottamāḥ pṛthak |
c sama-dhātuḥ samastāsu śreṣṭhā nindyā dvi-doṣa-jāḥ || 10 || Ah.1.1.010v/ 1-10cv sama-dhātuḥ samais tāsu
a tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaś calo 'nilaḥ |
c pittaṃ sa-sneha-tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu visraṃ saraṃ dravam || 11 ||
a snigdhaḥ śīto gurur mandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ kaphaḥ |
c saṃsargaḥ sannipātaś ca tad-dvi-tri-kṣaya-kopataḥ || 12 ||
a rasāsṛṅ-māṃsa-medo-'sthi-majja-śukrāṇi dhātavaḥ |
c sapta dūṣyā malā mūtra-śakṛt-svedādayo 'pi ca || 13 ||
a vṛddhiḥ samānaiḥ sarveṣāṃ viparītair viparyayaḥ |
c rasāḥ svādv-amla-lavaṇa-tiktoṣaṇa-kaṣāyakāḥ || 14 ||
a ṣaḍ dravyam āśritās te ca yathā-pūrvaṃ balāvahāḥ |
c tatrādyā mārutaṃ ghnanti trayas tiktādayaḥ kapham || 15 ||
a kaṣāya-tikta-madhurāḥ pittam anye tu kurvate |
c śamanaṃ kopanaṃ svastha-hitaṃ dravyam iti tri-dhā || 16 ||
a uṣṇa-śīta-guṇotkarṣāt tatra vīryaṃ dvi-dhā smṛtam |
c tri-dhā vipāko dravyasya svādv-amla-kaṭukātmakaḥ || 17 ||
a guru-manda-hima-snigdha-ślakṣṇa-sāndra-mṛdu-sthirāḥ |
c guṇāḥ sa-sūkṣma-viśadā viṃśatiḥ sa-viparyayāḥ || 18 ||
a kālārtha-karmaṇāṃ yogo hīna-mithyāti-mātrakaḥ |
c samyag-yogaś ca vijñeyo rogārogyaika-kāraṇam || 19 ||
a rogas tu doṣa-vaiṣamyaṃ doṣa-sāmyam a-roga-tā |
c nijāgantu-vibhāgena tatra rogā dvi-dhā smṛtāḥ || 20 ||
a teṣāṃ kāya-mano-bhedād adhiṣṭhānam api dvi-dhā |
c rajas tamaś ca manaso dvau ca doṣāv udāhṛtau || 21 || Ah.1.1.021v/ 1-21dv 'tra dvau doṣāv udāhṛtau
a darśana-sparśana-praśnaiḥ parīkṣeta ca rogiṇam |
c rogaṃ nidāna-prāg-rūpa-lakṣaṇopaśayāptibhiḥ || 22 || Ah.1.1.022v/ 1-22bv samparīkṣeta rogiṇam 1-22bv parīkṣetātha rogiṇam
a bhūmi-deha-prabhedena deśam āhur iha dvi-dhā |
c jāṅgalaṃ vāta-bhūyiṣṭham anūpaṃ tu kapholbaṇam || 23 ||
a sādhāraṇaṃ sama-malaṃ tri-dhā bhū-deśam ādiśet |
c kṣaṇādir vyādhy-avasthā ca kālo bheṣaja-yoga-kṛt || 24 ||
a śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ ceti samāsād auṣadhaṃ dvi-dhā |
c śarīra-jānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ krameṇa paramauṣadham || 25 ||
a vastir vireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu |
c dhī-dhairyātmādi-vijñānaṃ mano-doṣauṣadhaṃ param || 26 ||
a bhiṣag dravyāṇy upasthātā rogī pāda-catuṣṭayam |
c cikitsitasya nirdiṣṭaṃ praty-ekaṃ tac catur-guṇam || 27 ||
a dakṣas tīrthātta-śāstrārtho dṛṣṭa-karmā śucir bhiṣak |
c bahu-kalpaṃ bahu-guṇaṃ sampannaṃ yogyam auṣadham || 28 ||
a anuraktaḥ śucir dakṣo buddhi-mān paricārakaḥ |
c āḍhyo rogī bhiṣag-vaśyo jñāpakaḥ sat-tva-vān api || 29 ||
a sādhyo '-sādhya iti vyādhir dvi-dhā tau tu punar dvi-dhā |
c su-sādhyaḥ kṛcchra-sādhyaś ca yāpyo yaś cān-upakramaḥ || 29+(1) ||
a sarvauṣadha-kṣame dehe yūnaḥ puṃso jitātmanaḥ |
c a-marma-go 'lpa-hetv-agra-rūpa-rūpo 'n-upadravaḥ || 30 ||
a a-tulya-dūṣya-deśartu-prakṛtiḥ pāda-sampadi |
c graheṣv anu-guṇeṣv eka-doṣa-mārgo navaḥ sukhaḥ || 31 ||
a śastrādi-sādhanaḥ kṛcchraḥ saṅkare ca tato gadaḥ |
c śeṣa-tvād āyuṣo yāpyaḥ pathyābhyāsād viparyaye || 32 ||
a an-upakrama eva syāt sthito 'ty-anta-viparyaye |
c autsukya-mohā-rati-kṛd dṛṣṭa-riṣṭo 'kṣa-nāśanaḥ || 33 ||
a tyajed ārtaṃ bhiṣag-bhūpair dviṣṭaṃ teṣāṃ dviṣaṃ dviṣam |
c hīnopakaraṇaṃ vyagram a-vidheyaṃ gatāyuṣam || 34 ||
a caṇḍaṃ śokāturaṃ bhīruṃ kṛta-ghnaṃ vaidya-māninam |
c tantrasyāsya paraṃ cāto vakṣyate 'dhyāya-saṅgrahaḥ || 35 ||
a āyuṣ-kāma-dinartv-īhā-rogān-utpādana-dravāḥ |
c anna-jñānānna-saṃrakṣā-mātrā-dravya-rasāśrayāḥ || 36 ||
a doṣādi-jñāna-tad-bheda-tac-cikitsā-dvy-upakramāḥ |
c śuddhy-ādi-snehana-sveda-rekāsthāpana-nāvanam || 37 ||
a dhūma-gaṇḍūṣa-dṛk-seka-tṛpti-yantraka-śastrakam |
c sirā-vidhiḥ śalya-vidhiḥ śastra-kṣārāgni-karmikau || 38 || Ah.1.1.038v/ 1-38cv sirā-vyadhaḥ śalya-vidhiḥ
a sūtra-sthānam ime 'dhyāyās triṃśac chārīram ucyate |
c garbhāvakrānti-tad-vyāpad-aṅga-marma-vibhāgikam || 39 ||
a vikṛtir dūta-jaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ nidānaṃ sārvarogikam |
c jvarāsṛk-śvāsa-yakṣmādi-madādy-arśo-'tisāriṇām || 40 ||
a mūtrāghāta-pramehāṇāṃ vidradhy-ādy-udarasya ca |
c pāṇḍu-kuṣṭhānilārtānāṃ vātāsrasya ca ṣo-ḍaśa || 41 ||
a cikitsitaṃ jvare rakte kāse śvāse ca yakṣmaṇi |
c vamau madātyaye 'rśaḥsu viṣi dvau dvau ca mūtrite || 42 ||
a vidradhau gulma-jaṭhara-pāṇḍu-śopha-visarpiṣu |
c kuṣṭha-śvitrānila-vyādhi-vātāsreṣu cikitsitam || 43 ||
a dvā-viṃśatir ime 'dhyāyāḥ kalpa-siddhir ataḥ param |
c kalpo vamer virekasya tat-siddhir vasti-kalpanā || 44 ||
a siddhir vasty-āpadāṃ ṣaṣṭho dravya-kalpo 'ta uttaram |
c bālopacāre tad-vyādhau tad-grahe dvau ca bhūta-ge || 45 ||
a unmāde 'tha smṛti-bhraṃśe dvau dvau vartmasu sandhiṣu |
c dṛk-tamo-liṅga-nāśeṣu trayo dvau dvau ca sarva-ge || 46 ||
a karṇa-nāsā-mukha-śiro-vraṇe bhaṅge bhagandare |
c granthy-ādau kṣudra-rogeṣu guhya-roge pṛthag dvayam || 47 ||
a viṣe bhujaṅge kīṭeṣu mūṣakeṣu rasāyane |
c catvāriṃśo 'n-apatyānām adhyāyo bīja-poṣaṇaḥ || 48 || Ah.1.1.048v/ 1-48dv adhyāyo bīja-poṣaṇe
̆ ity adhyāya-śataṃ viṃśaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ sthānair udīritam || 48ū̆ ||
a brāhme muhūrta uttiṣṭhet svastho rakṣārtham āyuṣaḥ |
c śarīra-cintāṃ nirvartya kṛta-śauca-vidhis tataḥ || 1 ||
a arka-nyagrodha-khadira-karañja-kakubhādi-jam |
c prātar bhuktvā ca mṛdv-agraṃ kaṣāya-kaṭu-tiktakam || 2 ||
a kanīny-agra-sama-sthaulyaṃ praguṇaṃ dvā-daśāṅgulam |
c bhakṣayed danta-pavanaṃ danta-māṃsāny a-bādhayan || 3 || Ah.1.2.003v/ 2-3cv bhakṣayed danta-dhavanaṃ
a nādyād a-jīrṇa-vamathu-śvāsa-kāsa-jvarārditī |
c tṛṣṇāsya-pāka-hṛn-netra-śiraḥ-karṇāmayī ca tat || 4 ||
a sauvīram añjanaṃ nityaṃ hitam akṣṇos tato bhajet |
c cakṣus tejo-mayaṃ tasya viśeṣāc chleṣmato bhayam || 5 || Ah.1.2.005v/ 2-5dv viśeṣāc chleṣmaṇo bhayam
a bhukta-vāṃś ca śiraḥ-snātaḥ śrāntaḥ chardana-nāvanaiḥ |
c rātrau jāgaritaś cāpi nāñjyāj jvarita eva ca || 5-1+1 ||
a yojayet sapta-rātre 'smāt srāvaṇārthaṃ rasāñjanam |
c tato nāvana-gaṇḍūṣa-dhūma-tāmbūla-bhāg bhavet || 6 || Ah.1.2.006v/ 2-6bv srāvaṇārthe rasāñjanam
a tāmbūlaṃ kṣata-pittāsra-rūkṣotkupita-cakṣuṣām |
c viṣa-mūrchā-madārtānām a-pathyaṃ śoṣiṇām api || 7 ||
a abhyaṅgam ācaren nityaṃ sa jarā-śrama-vāta-hā |
c dṛṣṭi-prasāda-puṣṭy-āyuḥ-svapna-su-tvak-tva-dārḍhya-kṛt || 8 ||
a śiraḥ-śravaṇa-pādeṣu taṃ viśeṣeṇa śīlayet |
c varjyo 'bhyaṅgaḥ kapha-grasta-kṛta-saṃśuddhy-a-jīrṇibhiḥ || 9 ||
a lāghavaṃ karma-sāmarthyaṃ dīpto 'gnir medasaḥ kṣayaḥ |
c vibhakta-ghana-gātra-tvaṃ vyāyāmād upajāyate || 10 ||
a vāta-pittāmayī bālo vṛddho '-jīrṇo ca taṃ tyajet |
c ardha-śaktyā niṣevyas tu balibhiḥ snigdha-bhojibhiḥ || 11 ||
a śīta-kāle vasante ca mandam eva tato 'nya-dā |
c taṃ kṛtvānu-sukhaṃ dehaṃ mardayec ca samantataḥ || 12 ||
a tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ pratamako rakta-pittaṃ śramaḥ klamaḥ |
c ati-vyāyāmataḥ kāso jvaraś chardiś ca jāyate || 13 ||
a vyāyāma-jāgarādhva-strī-hāsya-bhāṣyādi-sāhasam |
c gajaṃ siṃha ivākarṣan bhajann ati vinaśyati || 14 || Ah.1.2.014v/ 2-14dv bhajan yato 'ti naśyati
a udvartanaṃ kapha-haraṃ medasaḥ pravilāyanam |
c sthirī-karaṇam aṅgānāṃ tvak-prasāda-karaṃ param || 15 ||
a dīpanaṃ vṛṣyam āyuṣyaṃ snānam ūrjā-bala-pradam |
c kaṇḍū-mala-śrama-sveda-tandrā-tṛḍ-dāha-pāpma-jit || 16 || Ah.1.2.016v/ 2-16bv snānam ojo-bala-pradam
a uṣṇāmbunādhaḥ-kāyasya pariṣeko balāvahaḥ |
c tenaiva tūttamāṅgasya bala-hṛt-keśa-cakṣuṣām || 17 || Ah.1.2.017v/ 2-17cv tenaiva cottamāṅgasya 2-17cv sa eva cottamāṅgasya 2-17cv sa eva tūttamāṅgasya
a snānam ardita-netrāsya-karṇa-rogātisāriṣu |
c ādhmāna-pīnasā-jīrṇa-bhukta-vatsu ca garhitam || 18 ||
a jīrṇe hitaṃ mitaṃ cādyān na vegān īrayed balāt |
c na vegito 'nya-kāryaḥ syān nā-jitvā sādhyam āmayam || 19 ||
a sukhārthāḥ sarva-bhūtānāṃ matāḥ sarvāḥ pravṛttayaḥ |
c sukhaṃ ca na vinā dharmāt tasmād dharma-paro bhavet || 20 ||
a bhaktyā kalyāṇa-mitrāṇi sevetetara-dūra-gaḥ |
c hiṃsā-steyān yathā-kāmaṃ paiśunyaṃ paruṣān-ṛte || 21 ||
a sambhinnālāpaṃ vyāpādam abhidhyāṃ dṛg-viparyayam |
c pāpaṃ karmeti daśa-dhā kāya-vāṅ-mānasais tyajet || 22 ||
a a-vṛtti-vyādhi-śokārtān anuvarteta śaktitaḥ |
c ātma-vat satataṃ paśyed api kīṭa-pipīlikam || 23 ||
a arcayed deva-go-vipra-vṛddha-vaidya-nṛpātithīn |
c vi-mukhān nārthinaḥ kuryān nāvamanyeta nākṣipet || 24 ||
a upakāra-pradhānaḥ syād apakāra-pare 'py arau |
c sampad-vipatsv eka-manā hetāv īrṣyet phale na tu || 25 ||
a kāle hitaṃ mitaṃ brūyād a-visaṃvādi peśalam |
c pūrvābhibhāṣī su-mukhaḥ su-śīlaḥ karuṇā-mṛduḥ || 26 ||
a naikaḥ sukhī na sarva-tra viśrabdho na ca śaṅkitaḥ |
c na kañ-cid ātmanaḥ śatruṃ nātmānaṃ kasya-cid ripum || 27 ||
a prakāśayen nāpamānaṃ na ca niḥ-sneha-tāṃ prabhoḥ |
c janasyāśayam ālakṣya yo yathā parituṣyati || 28 || Ah.1.2.028v/ 2-28av prakāśayen nāvamānaṃ
a taṃ tathaivānuvarteta parārādhana-paṇḍitaḥ |
c na pīḍayed indriyāṇi na caitāny ati lālayet || 29 ||
a tri-varga-śūnyaṃ nārambhaṃ bhajet taṃ cā-virodhayan |
c anuyāyāt prati-padaṃ sarva-dharmeṣu madhyamām || 30 ||
a nīca-roma-nakha-śmaśrur nir-malāṅghri-malāyanaḥ |
c snāna-śīlaḥ su-surabhiḥ su-veṣo 'n-ulbaṇojjvalaḥ || 31 || Ah.1.2.031v/ 2-31cv snāna-śīlaḥ sa-surabhiḥ
a dhārayet satataṃ ratna-siddha-mantra-mahauṣadhīḥ |
c sātapa-tra-pada-trāṇo vicared yuga-mātra-dṛk || 32 ||
a niśi cātyayike kārye daṇḍī maulī sahāya-vān |
c caitya-pūjya-dhvajā-śasta-cchāyā-bhasma-tuṣā-śucīn || 33 ||
a nākrāmec charkarā-loṣṭa-bali-snāna-bhuvo na ca |
c nadīṃ taren na bāhubhyāṃ nāgni-skandham abhivrajet || 34 ||
a sandigdha-nāvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ ca nārohed duṣṭa-yāna-vat |
c nā-saṃvṛta-mukhaḥ kuryāt kṣuti-hāsya-vijṛmbhaṇam || 35 || Ah.1.2.035v/ 2-35dv kṣutiṃ hāsyaṃ vijṛmbhaṇam 2-35dv kṣut-hāsyaṃ ca vijṛmbhaṇam
a nāsikāṃ na vikuṣṇīyān nā-kasmād vilikhed bhuvam |
c nāṅgaiś ceṣṭeta vi-guṇaṃ nāsītotkaṭakaś ciram || 36 || Ah.1.2.036v/ 2-36bv nā-kasmād vilikhen mahīm 2-36dv nāsītotkaṭaka-sthitaḥ
a deha-vāk-cetasāṃ ceṣṭāḥ prāk śramād vinivartayet |
c nordhva-jānuś ciraṃ tiṣṭhen naktaṃ seveta na drumam || 37 ||
a tathā catvara-caityāntaś-catuṣ-patha-surālayān |
c sūnāṭavī-śūnya-gṛha-śmaśānāni divāpi na || 38 ||
a a-sammārjitam ādarśam an-upaskṛta-kāminīm |
c rajasvalāṃ ca nekṣeta sadā prātar a-maṅgalam || 38+1 ||
a sarva-thekṣeta nādityaṃ na bhāraṃ śirasā vahet |
c nekṣeta pratataṃ sūkṣmaṃ dīptā-medhyā-priyāṇi ca || 39 ||
a madya-vikraya-sandhāna-dānādānāni nācaret |
c puro-vātātapa-rajas-tuṣāra-paruṣānilān || 40 ||
a an-ṛjuḥ kṣavathūdgāra-kāsa-svapnānna-maithunam |
c kūla-cchāyāṃ nṛpa-dviṣṭaṃ vyāla-daṃṣṭri-viṣāṇinaḥ || 41 ||
a hīnān-āryāti-nipuṇa-sevāṃ vigraham uttamaiḥ |
c sandhyāsv abhyavahāra-strī-svapnādhyayana-cintanam || 42 ||
a śatru-sattra-gaṇākīrṇa-gaṇikā-paṇikāśanam |
c gātra-vaktra-nakhair vādyaṃ hasta-keśāvadhūnanam || 43 ||
a toyāgni-pūjya-madhyena yānaṃ dhūmaṃ śavāśrayam |
c madyāti-saktiṃ viśrambha-svātantrye strīṣu ca tyajet || 44 ||
a ācāryaḥ sarva-ceṣṭāsu loka eva hi dhī-mataḥ |
c anukuryāt tam evāto laukike 'rthe parīkṣakaḥ || 45 ||
a ārdra-santāna-tā tyāgaḥ kāya-vāk-cetasāṃ damaḥ |
c svārtha-buddhiḥ parārtheṣu paryāptam iti sad-vratam || 46 ||
a naktan-dināni me yānti katham-bhūtasya samprati |
c duḥkha-bhāṅ na bhavaty evaṃ nityaṃ sannihita-smṛtiḥ || 47 ||
a evaṃ kṛtsna-dinaṃ nītvā rātrau yāme gṛhe gate |
c devān ṛṣīn gurūn smṛtvā tataḥ śayanam ācaret || 47+1 || Ah.1.2.047+1v/ 2-47+1bv rātrer yāme gate sati
a ity ācāraḥ samāsena yaṃ prāpnoti samācaran |
c āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ yaśo lokāṃś ca śāśvatān || 48 ||
a māsair dvi-saṅkhyair māghādyaiḥ kramāt ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥ |
c śiśiro 'tha vasantaś ca grīṣmo varṣā-śarad-dhimāḥ || 1 ||
a śiśirādyās tribhis tais tu vidyād ayanam uttaram |
c ādānaṃ ca tad ādatte nṛṇāṃ prati-dinaṃ balam || 2 ||
a tasmin hy aty-artha-tīkṣṇoṣṇa-rūkṣā mārga-sva-bhāvataḥ |
c āditya-pavanāḥ saumyān kṣapayanti guṇān bhuvaḥ || 3 ||
a tiktaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaṭuko balino 'tra rasāḥ kramāt |
c tasmād ādānam āgneyam ṛtavo dakṣiṇāyanam || 4 ||
a varṣādayo visargaś ca yad balaṃ visṛjaty ayam |

c yad yac ca kiñ-cid iṣṭaṃ manaso vājī-karaṃ tat tat || 45 || Ah.6.40.045v/ 40-45bv kāntāḥ kāntā niśāḥ śaśāṅkāṅkāḥ 40-45dv manaso vājī-karaṃ hi tat
a madhu mukham iva sotpalaṃ priyāyāḥ kala-raṇanā parivādinī priyeva |
c kusuma-caya-mano-ramā ca śayyā kisalayinī latikeva puṣpitāgrā || 46 || Ah.6.40.046v/ 40-46bv kala-raṇanā priya-vādinī priyeva 40-46cv kusuma-caya-mano-harā ca śayyā
a deśe śarīre ca na kā-cid artir artheṣu nālpo 'pi mano-vidhānaḥ |
c vājī-karāḥ sannihitāś ca yogāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ paripūrayanti || 47 || Ah.6.40.047v/ 40-47av deśe śarīre na kadā-cid artir 40-47bv artheṣu nālpo 'pi mano-'bhighātaḥ
a mustā parpaṭakaṃ jvare tṛṣi jalaṃ mṛd-bhṛṣṭa-loṣṭodbhavaṃ || 48a ||
b lājāś chardiṣu vasti-jeṣu girijaṃ meheṣu dhātrī-niśe || 48b ||
c pāṇḍau śreṣṭham ayo 'bhayānila-kaphe plīhāmaye pippalī || 48c ||
d sandhāne kṛmijā viṣe śukatarur medo-'nile gugguluḥ || 48d ||
a vṛṣo 'sra-pitte kuṭajo 'tisāre bhallātako 'rśaḥsu gareṣu hema |
c sthūleṣu tārkṣyaṃ kṛmiṣu kṛmighnaṃ śoṣe surā chāga-payo 'tha māṃsam || 49 || Ah.6.40.049v/ 40-49bv bhallātam arśaḥsu gareṣu hema
a akṣy-āmayeṣu tri-phalā guḍūcī vātāsra-roge mathitaṃ grahaṇyām |
c kuṣṭheṣu sevyaḥ khadirasya sāraḥ sarveṣu rogeṣu śilāhvayaṃ ca || 50 ||
a unmādaṃ ghṛtam a-navaṃ śokaṃ madyaṃ vyapasmṛtiṃ brāhmī |
c nidrā-nāśaṃ kṣīraṃ jayati rasālā pratiśyāyam || 51 || Ah.6.40.051v/ 40-51bv śokaṃ madyaṃ visaṃsmṛtiṃ brāhmī
a māṃsaṃ kārśyaṃ laśunaḥ prabhañjanaṃ stabdha-gātra-tāṃ svedaḥ |
c guḍamañjaryāḥ khapuro nasyāt skandhāṃsa-bāhu-rujam || 52 || Ah.6.40.052v/ 40-52dv nasyaṃ skandhāṃsa-bāhu-rujam
a nava-nīta-khaṇḍa-marditam auṣṭraṃ mūtraṃ payaś ca hanty udaram |
c nasyaṃ mūrdha-vikārān vidradhim a-cirotthitam asra-visrāvaḥ || 53 || Ah.6.40.053v/ 40-53bv auṣṭrī-mūtraṃ payaś ca hanty udaram 40-53cv nasyaṃ cordhva-vikārān 40-53cv nasyaṃ mūrdhni vikārān
a nasyaṃ kavaḍo mukha-jān nasyāñjana-tarpaṇāni netra-rujaḥ |
c vṛddhasya kṣīra-ghṛte mūrchāṃ śītāmbu-māruta-cchāyāḥ || 54 || Ah.6.40.054v/ 40-54av nasyaṃ kavaḍaṃ mukha-gadān 40-54av nasyaṃ kevalaṃ mukha-gadān 40-54av nasyaṃ kavaḍaṃ mukha-jān
a sama-śuktārdraka-mātrā mande vahnau śrame surā snānam |

c duḥkha-saha-tve sthairye vyāyāmo gokṣurur hitaḥ kṛcchre || 55 || Ah.6.40.055v/ 40-55av sama-śuṣkārdraka-mātrā 40-55bv mande vahnau śrame surā-pānam 40-55cv duḥkha-saha-tvaṃ sthairye 40-55cv duḥkha-saha-tvaṃ sthaulye
a kāse nidigdhikā pārśva-śūle puṣkara-jā jaṭā |
c vayasaḥ sthāpane dhātrī tri-phalā guggulur vraṇe || 56 || Ah.6.40.056v/ 40-56av kāse nidigdhikā-pānaṃ 40-56bv pārśva-śūle ca pauṣkaram 40-56cv vayaḥ-saṃsthāpane dhātrī
a vastir vāta-vikārān paittān rekaḥ kaphodbhavān vamanam |
c kṣaudraṃ jayati balāsaṃ sarpiḥ pittaṃ samīraṇaṃ tailam || 57 ||
a ity agryaṃ yat proktaṃ rogāṇām auṣadhaṃ śamāyālam |
c tad deśa-kāla-balato vikalpanīyaṃ yathā-yogam || 58 ||
a ity ātreyād āgamayyārtha-sūtraṃ tat-sūktānāṃ peśalānām a-tṛptaḥ |

c bheḍādīnāṃ sammato bhakti-namraḥ papracchedaṃ saṃśayāno 'gniveśaḥ || 59 || Ah.6.40.059v/ 40-59av ity ātreyād āgamād ārtha-sūkṣmaṃ 40-59av ity ātreyād āgamayyārtha-sūkṣmaṃ 40-59bv tat-sūktīnāṃ peśalānām a-tṛptaḥ
a dṛśyante bhaga-van ke-cid ātma-vanto 'pi rogiṇaḥ |
c dravyopasthātṛ-sampannā vṛddha-vaidya-matānugāḥ || 60 ||
a kṣīyamāṇāmaya-prāṇā viparītās tathā 'pare |
c hitā-hita-vibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmād a-niścitam || 61 ||
a kiṃ śāsti śāstram asmin iti kalpayato 'gniveśa-mukhyasya |
c śiṣya-gaṇasya punarvasur ācakhyau kārtsnyatas tat-tvam || 62 || Ah.6.40.062v/ 40-62dv ācakṣe kārtsnyatas tat-tvam
a na cikitsā-cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitum arhati |
c vināpi kriyayā svāsthyaṃ gacchatāṃ ṣo-ḍaśāṃśayā || 63 ||
a ātaṅka-paṅka-magnānāṃ hastālambo bhiṣag-jitam |
c jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣām eva nauṣadhāt || 64 || Ah.6.40.064v/ 40-64dv sarveṣām eva nauṣadham
a na hy upāyam apekṣante sarve rogā na cānya-thā |
c upāya-sādhyāḥ sidhyanti nā-hetur hetu-mān yataḥ || 65 || Ah.6.40.065v/ 40-65dv no '-hetur hetu-māṃs tataḥ
a yad uktaṃ sarva-sampatti-yuktayāpi cikitsayā |
c mṛtyur bhavati tan naivaṃ nopāye 'sty an-upāya-tā || 66 || Ah.6.40.066v/ 40-66dv nopāyeṣv an-upāya-tā
a api copāya-yuktasya dhī-mato jātu cit kriyā |
c na sidhyed daiva-vaiguṇyān na tv iyaṃ ṣo-ḍaśātmikā || 67 || Ah.6.40.067v/ 40-67av apy evopāya-yuktasya 40-67cv na siddhir daiva-vaiguṇyān 40-67dv na nv iyaṃ ṣo-ḍaśātmikā
a kasyā-siddho 'gni-toyādiḥ sveda-stambhādi-karmaṇi |
c na prīṇanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vā kasya kṣīraṃ gavedhukam || 68 || Ah.6.40.068v/ 40-68cv na prīṇanaṃ karśanaṃ vā 40-68dv kasya kṣīra-gavedhukam
a kasya māṣātmaguptādau vṛṣya-tve nāsti niścayaḥ |
c viṇ-mūtra-karaṇākṣepau kasya saṃśayitau yave || 69 || Ah.6.40.069v/ 40-69av kasya māṣātmaguptādyair 40-69bv vṛṣa-tve nāsti niścayaḥ
a viṣaṃ kasya jarāṃ yāti mantra-tantra-vivarjitam |
c kaḥ prāptaḥ kalya-tāṃ pathyād ṛte rohiṇikādiṣu || 70 || Ah.6.40.070v/ 40-70cv kaḥ prāptaḥ kalpa-tāṃ pathyād
a api cā-kāla-maraṇaṃ sarva-siddhānta-niścitam |
c mahatāpi prayatnena vāryatāṃ katham anya-thā || 71 ||
a candanādy api dāhādau rūḍham āgama-pūrvakam |
c śāstrād eva gataṃ siddhiṃ jvare laṅghana-bṛṃhaṇam || 72 ||
a catuṣ-pād-guṇa-sampanne samyag ālocya yojite |
c mā kṛthā vyādhi-nirghātaṃ vicikitsāṃ cikitsite || 73 || Ah.6.40.073v/ 40-73av catuṣ-pād-guṇa-sampūrṇe 40-73cv mā kṛthā vyādhi-nirghāte
a etad dhi mṛtyu-pāśānām a-kāṇḍe chedanaṃ dṛḍham |
c rogottrāsita-bhītānāṃ rakṣā-sūtram a-sūtrakam || 74 ||
a etat tad amṛtaṃ sākṣāj jagad-āyāsa-varjitam |
c yāti hālāhala-tvaṃ tu sadyo dur-bhājana-sthitam || 75 || Ah.6.40.075v/ 40-75av etad vedāmṛtaṃ sākṣāj 40-75bv jagaty āyāsa-varjitam 40-75cv yāti hālāhala-tvaṃ ca
a a-jñāta-śāstra-sad-bhāvāñ chāstra-mātra-parāyaṇān |
c tyajed dūrād bhiṣak-pāśān pāśān vaivasvatān iva || 76 || Ah.6.40.076v/ 40-76cv vivarjayed bhiṣak-pāśān
a bhiṣajāṃ sādhu-vṛttānāṃ bhadram āgama-śālinām |
c abhyasta-karmaṇāṃ bhadraṃ bhadraṃ bhadrābhilāṣiṇām || 77 || Ah.6.40.077v/ 40-77bv bahu-dhāgama-śālinām 40-77bv bhadram āgama-śīlinām 40-77cv abhyasta-karmaṇāṃ siddhir
a iti tantra-guṇair yuktaṃ tantra-doṣair vivarjitam |
c cikitsā-śāstram a-khilaṃ vyāpya yat paritaḥ sthitam || 78 || Ah.6.40.078v/ 40-78bv tantra-doṣa-vivarjitam 40-78dv vyāpaṭhya paritaḥ sthitam
a vipulā-mala-vijñāna-mahā-muni-matānugam |

c mahā-sāgara-gambhīra-saṅgrahārthopalakṣaṇam || 79 || Ah.6.40.079v/ 40-79av vipulā-mala-vijñānaṃ 40-79cv mahā-sāgara-gambhīraṃ 40-79cv mahā-muni-matānugam 40-79dv saṅgrahārthopalakṣaṇam 40-79dv saṅgrahārthopalakṣakam
a aṣṭāṅga-vaidyaka-mahodadhi-manthanena yo 'ṣṭāṅga-saṅgraha-mahāmṛta-rāśir āptaḥ |

c tasmād an-alpa-phalam alpa-samudyamānāṃ prīty-artham etad uditaṃ pṛthag eva tantram || 80 || Ah.6.40.080v/ 40-80bv yo 'ṣṭāṅga-saṅgraha-mahāmṛta-sāra-tulyaḥ 40-80dv prīty-artham evam uditaṃ pṛthag eva tantram
a idam āgama-siddha-tvāt pratyakṣa-phala-darśanāt |
c mantra-vat samprayoktavyaṃ na mīmāṃsyaṃ kathañ-ca-na || 81 || Ah.6.40.081v/ 40-81av idam āgama-śuddha-tvāt 40-81dv na mīmāṃsyaṃ kadā-ca-na
a dīrgha-jīvitam ārogyaṃ dharmam arthaṃ sukhaṃ yaśaḥ |
c pāṭhāvabodhānuṣṭhānair adhigacchaty ato dhruvam || 82 || Ah.6.40.082v/ 40-82av dīrghaṃ jīvitam ārogyaṃ
a etat paṭhan saṅgraha-bodha-śaktaḥ sv-abhyasta-karmā bhiṣag a-prakampyaḥ |
c ākampayaty anya-viśāla-tantra-kṛtābhiyogān yadi tan na citram || 83 || Ah.6.40.083v/ 40-83cv yaḥ kampayaty anya-viśāla-tantra-
a yadi carakam adhīte tad dhruvaṃ suśrutādi-praṇigadita-gadānāṃ nāma-mātre 'pi bāhyaḥ |

c atha caraka-vihīnaḥ prakriyāyām a-klinnaḥ kim iva khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ || 84 || Ah.6.40.084v/ 40-84bv -praṇigadita-gadānāṃ nāma-mātreṇa bāhyaḥ 40-84bv -pratigadita-gadānāṃ nāma-mātre 'pi bāhyaḥ 40-84dv kim iha khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ
a abhiniveśa-vaśād abhiyujyate su-bhaṇite 'pi na yo dṛḍha-mūḍhakaḥ |
c paṭhatu yatna-paraḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ sa khalu vaidyakam ādyam a-nirvidaḥ || 85 ||
a vāte pitte śleṣma-śāntau ca pathyaṃ tailaṃ sarpir mākṣikaṃ ca krameṇa |
c etad brahmā bhāṣatāṃ brahma-jo vā kā nir-mantre vaktṛ-bhedokti-śaktiḥ || 86 || Ah.6.40.086v/ 40-86cv etad brahmā bhāṣate brahma-jo vā
a abhidhātṛ-vaśāt kiṃ vā dravya-śaktir viśiṣyate |
c ato matsaram utsṛjya mādhyasthyam avalambyatām || 87 || Ah.6.40.087v/ 40-87av abhidhātur vaśāt kiñ-cid
a ṛṣi-praṇīte prītiś cen muktvā caraka-suśrutau |
c bheḍādyāḥ kiṃ na paṭhyante tasmād grāhyaṃ su-bhāṣitam || 88 ||
a hṛdayam iva hṛdayam etat sarvāyur-veda-vāṅ-maya-payo-dheḥ |
c kṛtvā yac chubham āptaṃ śubham astu paraṃ tato jagataḥ || 89 ||

lines: a rāgādi-rogān satatānuṣaktān a-śeṣa-kāya-prasṛtān a-śeṣān |
c autsukya-mohā-rati-dāñ jaghāna yo '-pūrva-vaidyāya namo 'stu tasmai || 1 ||
a āyuḥ-kāmayamānena dharmārtha-sukha-sādhanam |
c āyur-vedopadeśeṣu vidheyaḥ param ādaraḥ || 2 ||
a brahmā smṛtvāyuṣo vedaṃ prajāpatim ajigrahat |
c so 'śvinau tau sahasrākṣaṃ so 'tri-putrādikān munīn || 3 ||
a te 'gniveśādikāṃs te tu pṛthak tantrāṇi tenire |
c tebhyo 'ti-viprakīrṇebhyaḥ prāyaḥ sāra-taroccayaḥ || 4 ||
a kriyate 'ṣṭāṅga-hṛdayaṃ nāti-saṅkṣepa-vistaram |
c kāya-bāla-grahordhvāṅga-śalya-daṃṣṭrā-jarā-vṛṣān || 5 || Ah.1.1.005v/ 1-5bv nāti-saṅkṣipta-vistṛtam
a aṣṭāv aṅgāni tasyāhuś cikitsā yeṣu saṃśritā |
c vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaś ceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ || 6 ||
a vikṛtā-vikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vartayanti ca |
c te vyāpino 'pi hṛn-nābhyor adho-madhyordhva-saṃśrayāḥ || 7 || Ah.1.1.007v/ 1-7bv ghnanti te vardhayanti ca
a vayo-'ho-rātri-bhuktānāṃ te 'nta-madhyādi-gāḥ kramāt |
c tair bhaved viṣamas tīkṣṇo mandaś cāgniḥ samaiḥ samaḥ || 8 ||
a koṣṭhaḥ krūro mṛdur madhyo madhyaḥ syāt taiḥ samair api |
c śukrārtava-sthair janmādau viṣeṇeva viṣa-krimeḥ || 9 ||
a taiś ca tisraḥ prakṛtayo hīna-madhyottamāḥ pṛthak |
c sama-dhātuḥ samastāsu śreṣṭhā nindyā dvi-doṣa-jāḥ || 10 || Ah.1.1.010v/ 1-10cv sama-dhātuḥ samais tāsu
a tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaś calo 'nilaḥ |
c pittaṃ sa-sneha-tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu visraṃ saraṃ dravam || 11 ||
a snigdhaḥ śīto gurur mandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ kaphaḥ |
c saṃsargaḥ sannipātaś ca tad-dvi-tri-kṣaya-kopataḥ || 12 ||
a rasāsṛṅ-māṃsa-medo-'sthi-majja-śukrāṇi dhātavaḥ |
c sapta dūṣyā malā mūtra-śakṛt-svedādayo 'pi ca || 13 ||
a vṛddhiḥ samānaiḥ sarveṣāṃ viparītair viparyayaḥ |
c rasāḥ svādv-amla-lavaṇa-tiktoṣaṇa-kaṣāyakāḥ || 14 ||
a ṣaḍ dravyam āśritās te ca yathā-pūrvaṃ balāvahāḥ |
c tatrādyā mārutaṃ ghnanti trayas tiktādayaḥ kapham || 15 ||
a kaṣāya-tikta-madhurāḥ pittam anye tu kurvate |
c śamanaṃ kopanaṃ svastha-hitaṃ dravyam iti tri-dhā || 16 ||
a uṣṇa-śīta-guṇotkarṣāt tatra vīryaṃ dvi-dhā smṛtam |
c tri-dhā vipāko dravyasya svādv-amla-kaṭukātmakaḥ || 17 ||
a guru-manda-hima-snigdha-ślakṣṇa-sāndra-mṛdu-sthirāḥ |
c guṇāḥ sa-sūkṣma-viśadā viṃśatiḥ sa-viparyayāḥ || 18 ||
a kālārtha-karmaṇāṃ yogo hīna-mithyāti-mātrakaḥ |
c samyag-yogaś ca vijñeyo rogārogyaika-kāraṇam || 19 ||
a rogas tu doṣa-vaiṣamyaṃ doṣa-sāmyam a-roga-tā |
c nijāgantu-vibhāgena tatra rogā dvi-dhā smṛtāḥ || 20 ||
a teṣāṃ kāya-mano-bhedād adhiṣṭhānam api dvi-dhā |
c rajas tamaś ca manaso dvau ca doṣāv udāhṛtau || 21 || Ah.1.1.021v/ 1-21dv 'tra dvau doṣāv udāhṛtau
a darśana-sparśana-praśnaiḥ parīkṣeta ca rogiṇam |
c rogaṃ nidāna-prāg-rūpa-lakṣaṇopaśayāptibhiḥ || 22 || Ah.1.1.022v/ 1-22bv samparīkṣeta rogiṇam 1-22bv parīkṣetātha rogiṇam
a bhūmi-deha-prabhedena deśam āhur iha dvi-dhā |
c jāṅgalaṃ vāta-bhūyiṣṭham anūpaṃ tu kapholbaṇam || 23 ||
a sādhāraṇaṃ sama-malaṃ tri-dhā bhū-deśam ādiśet |
c kṣaṇādir vyādhy-avasthā ca kālo bheṣaja-yoga-kṛt || 24 ||
a śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ ceti samāsād auṣadhaṃ dvi-dhā |
c śarīra-jānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ krameṇa paramauṣadham || 25 ||
a vastir vireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu |
c dhī-dhairyātmādi-vijñānaṃ mano-doṣauṣadhaṃ param || 26 ||
a bhiṣag dravyāṇy upasthātā rogī pāda-catuṣṭayam |
c cikitsitasya nirdiṣṭaṃ praty-ekaṃ tac catur-guṇam || 27 ||
a dakṣas tīrthātta-śāstrārtho dṛṣṭa-karmā śucir bhiṣak |
c bahu-kalpaṃ bahu-guṇaṃ sampannaṃ yogyam auṣadham || 28 ||
a anuraktaḥ śucir dakṣo buddhi-mān paricārakaḥ |
c āḍhyo rogī bhiṣag-vaśyo jñāpakaḥ sat-tva-vān api || 29 ||
a sādhyo '-sādhya iti vyādhir dvi-dhā tau tu punar dvi-dhā |
c su-sādhyaḥ kṛcchra-sādhyaś ca yāpyo yaś cān-upakramaḥ || 29+(1) ||
a sarvauṣadha-kṣame dehe yūnaḥ puṃso jitātmanaḥ |
c a-marma-go 'lpa-hetv-agra-rūpa-rūpo 'n-upadravaḥ || 30 ||
a a-tulya-dūṣya-deśartu-prakṛtiḥ pāda-sampadi |
c graheṣv anu-guṇeṣv eka-doṣa-mārgo navaḥ sukhaḥ || 31 ||
a śastrādi-sādhanaḥ kṛcchraḥ saṅkare ca tato gadaḥ |
c śeṣa-tvād āyuṣo yāpyaḥ pathyābhyāsād viparyaye || 32 ||
a an-upakrama eva syāt sthito 'ty-anta-viparyaye |
c autsukya-mohā-rati-kṛd dṛṣṭa-riṣṭo 'kṣa-nāśanaḥ || 33 ||
a tyajed ārtaṃ bhiṣag-bhūpair dviṣṭaṃ teṣāṃ dviṣaṃ dviṣam |
c hīnopakaraṇaṃ vyagram a-vidheyaṃ gatāyuṣam || 34 ||
a caṇḍaṃ śokāturaṃ bhīruṃ kṛta-ghnaṃ vaidya-māninam |
c tantrasyāsya paraṃ cāto vakṣyate 'dhyāya-saṅgrahaḥ || 35 ||
a āyuṣ-kāma-dinartv-īhā-rogān-utpādana-dravāḥ |
c anna-jñānānna-saṃrakṣā-mātrā-dravya-rasāśrayāḥ || 36 ||
a doṣādi-jñāna-tad-bheda-tac-cikitsā-dvy-upakramāḥ |
c śuddhy-ādi-snehana-sveda-rekāsthāpana-nāvanam || 37 ||

c cikitsā-śāstram a-khilaṃ vyāpya yat paritaḥ sthitam || 78 || Ah.6.40.078v/ 40-78bv tantra-doṣa-vivarjitam 40-78dv vyāpaṭhya paritaḥ sthitam
a vipulā-mala-vijñāna-mahā-muni-matānugam |

c mahā-sāgara-gambhīra-saṅgrahārthopalakṣaṇam || 79 || Ah.6.40.079v/ 40-79av vipulā-mala-vijñānaṃ 40-79cv mahā-sāgara-gambhīraṃ 40-79cv mahā-muni-matānugam 40-79dv saṅgrahārthopalakṣaṇam 40-79dv saṅgrahārthopalakṣakam
a aṣṭāṅga-vaidyaka-mahodadhi-manthanena yo 'ṣṭāṅga-saṅgraha-mahāmṛta-rāśir āptaḥ |

c tasmād an-alpa-phalam alpa-samudyamānāṃ prīty-artham etad uditaṃ pṛthag eva tantram || 80 || Ah.6.40.080v/ 40-80bv yo 'ṣṭāṅga-saṅgraha-mahāmṛta-sāra-tulyaḥ 40-80dv prīty-artham evam uditaṃ pṛthag eva tantram
a idam āgama-siddha-tvāt pratyakṣa-phala-darśanāt |
c mantra-vat samprayoktavyaṃ na mīmāṃsyaṃ kathañ-ca-na || 81 || Ah.6.40.081v/ 40-81av idam āgama-śuddha-tvāt 40-81dv na mīmāṃsyaṃ kadā-ca-na
a dīrgha-jīvitam ārogyaṃ dharmam arthaṃ sukhaṃ yaśaḥ |
c pāṭhāvabodhānuṣṭhānair adhigacchaty ato dhruvam || 82 || Ah.6.40.082v/ 40-82av dīrghaṃ jīvitam ārogyaṃ
a etat paṭhan saṅgraha-bodha-śaktaḥ sv-abhyasta-karmā bhiṣag a-prakampyaḥ |
c ākampayaty anya-viśāla-tantra-kṛtābhiyogān yadi tan na citram || 83 || Ah.6.40.083v/ 40-83cv yaḥ kampayaty anya-viśāla-tantra-
a yadi carakam adhīte tad dhruvaṃ suśrutādi-praṇigadita-gadānāṃ nāma-mātre 'pi bāhyaḥ |

c atha caraka-vihīnaḥ prakriyāyām a-klinnaḥ kim iva khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ || 84 || Ah.6.40.084v/ 40-84bv -praṇigadita-gadānāṃ nāma-mātreṇa bāhyaḥ 40-84bv -pratigadita-gadānāṃ nāma-mātre 'pi bāhyaḥ 40-84dv kim iha khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ
a abhiniveśa-vaśād abhiyujyate su-bhaṇite 'pi na yo dṛḍha-mūḍhakaḥ |
c paṭhatu yatna-paraḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ sa khalu vaidyakam ādyam a-nirvidaḥ || 85 ||
a vāte pitte śleṣma-śāntau ca pathyaṃ tailaṃ sarpir mākṣikaṃ ca krameṇa |
c etad brahmā bhāṣatāṃ brahma-jo vā kā nir-mantre vaktṛ-bhedokti-śaktiḥ || 86 || Ah.6.40.086v/ 40-86cv etad brahmā bhāṣate brahma-jo vā
a abhidhātṛ-vaśāt kiṃ vā dravya-śaktir viśiṣyate |
c ato matsaram utsṛjya mādhyasthyam avalambyatām || 87 || Ah.6.40.087v/ 40-87av abhidhātur vaśāt kiñ-cid
a ṛṣi-praṇīte prītiś cen muktvā caraka-suśrutau |
c bheḍādyāḥ kiṃ na paṭhyante tasmād grāhyaṃ su-bhāṣitam || 88 ||
a hṛdayam iva hṛdayam etat sarvāyur-veda-vāṅ-maya-payo-dheḥ |
c kṛtvā yac chubham āptaṃ śubham astu paraṃ tato jagataḥ || 89 ||
